create.name: True North Insight / Voie boréale
create.bio:
True North Insight, known in French as Voie boréale, is a Canadian charity that teaches Buddhist insight meditation in both English and French. It was set up in 2003 by Pascal Auclair, Daryl Lynn Ross and David Schouela, and today a council of guiding teachers shapes its programme, among them Roxanne Dault, Jeanne Corrigal, Jill Davey, Jean Esther and Tara Mulay. The teaching follows the Theravada-based Western insight lineage, much of it from the Mahasi Sayadaw line, and several of its teachers also lead retreats at the Insight Meditation Society and Spirit Rock.

Run from Montreal by a small organising committee and a network of volunteers in Quebec and Ontario, the charity has no centre of its own. Instead it rents retreat houses such as the Galilee Centre in Arnprior, Ontario, and Kio-o in the Laurentians for silent residential retreats priced on a sliding scale, with teachers supported by dana. Through the week it hosts practice groups in person and on Zoom, including a Sunday sangha in Montreal, French-language sits and an affinity group for Black, Indigenous and racialised practitioners. Talks are archived on Dharma Seed and its YouTube channel, and it mentors new community meditation teachers.

courses.title: Cœur vaste, esprit libre (Pascal Auclair)
courses.description: A six-night silent retreat taught in French by co-founder Pascal Auclair at Kio-o in the Laurentians. Sitting, walking and teaching sessions focus on settling the mind and growing clarity, openness and inner steadiness.

courses.title: New Year's Insight Meditation Retreat (Jill Davey)
courses.description: Four nights in silence at the Galilee Centre in Arnprior, Ontario, over the turn of the year. Jill Davey, assisted by Elisabeth Schramm, teaches on wisdom and compassion through instruction, sitting and walking practice, talks and small-group meetings.

courses.title: A Heart That Resonates (Pascal Auclair)
courses.description: A week-long silent insight retreat in English with Pascal Auclair at the Galilee Centre. Guided sitting, walking practice and talks on the Buddha's teaching explore meeting the whole of experience with balance.

courses.title: Already Good: A BIPOC Retreat on Bodhicitta (Kate Johnson)
courses.description: A weekend affinity retreat for Black, Indigenous and people of colour, led by Kate Johnson at the Galilee Centre. Guided meditation, talks and inquiry centre on the awakened heart and on resting in open awareness.

courses.title: Abiding Mindfully in the Body: Meditation and Yoga Retreat (2027)
courses.description: A silent four-night retreat with co-founders Daryl Lynn Ross and David Schouela, pairing body-based insight practice with two or three yoga sessions a day. Loving-kindness and compassion are woven through the teaching.

free_resources.title: TNI Weekly Practice Groups
free_resources.description: The weekly timetable of sitting groups in English and French, in Montreal and on Zoom, including the Sunday sangha with Daryl Lynn Ross and an online affinity group for racialised practitioners.

free_resources.title: Audio Talks
free_resources.description: A gateway to the recorded dharma talks and meditation instructions from True North Insight retreats, which are kept on Dharma Seed and free to stream.

flags: Main YouTube count unreadable (consent page, 9 Nov 2026).
No published email: the contact page's address is assembled by JavaScript (Joomla spam cloak), so it counts as hidden; the page's message form is used instead.
No centre building: base is Montreal (its postal address and Sunday sangha); retreats run at rented venues (Galilee Centre, Arnprior ON; Kio-o, Sainte-Lucie-des-Laurentides QC).
Only one usable photo: a community group shot ('TNI au parc', 500 px). The site's other images are teacher headshots, a stock-looking Buddha image and a rented venue (Kio-o), so they were not used.

Political content: the About menu carries a 'Message about Gaza' (May 2024) and a 'Letter of Solidarity in Times of Upheaval' (May 2025); the site is not centred on them, so the centre is kept. Owner may wish to review.
Prices are shown with '$' and no currency code on the site (Canadian charity; currency not stated), so no code was added.
Lead teacher Jacoby Ballard is not named on TNI's site, so not linked; his one video is from TNI's channel per our earlier plan.
Dawn Mauricio is linked on the strength of TNI's own pages naming her on the teaching team of its Community Dharma Leader mentorship and as a past board member; owner may prefer to drop her.
Name kept bilingual as on its YouTube channel and site; slug true-north-insight.
Earlier slip: before confirming the domain I requested truenorthinsight.org/robots.txt once (guessed domain); the domain was then confirmed from the link on tni.dharmaseed.org.

Other 2027 retreats (Thanksgiving, summer French retreat, 2027 Cœur vaste) and online daylongs: kept to five offerings.
